description: Offline screenshot clipboard with annotation, OCR, screen recording, quick redaction, and step-by-step guides.
notes: Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime. Windows 11 includes it; most Windows 10 computers have it. This extracted package does not install it.
The vendor installer hooks are skipped: .snpr, .snpd, and .snpt file associations are not registered. App data remains in %APPDATA%\SecondDawn\snipmunk and %LOCALAPPDATA%\lab.seconddawn.snipmunk.
The built-in updater is enabled by default. Disable update checks in Settings > About to keep updates under Scoop.
